PlanName: Fully Loved, Fully Known: Known by God. Loved Without Limits.
PlanIntro: Do you ever feel unseen, misunderstood, or like you don’t quite measure up? The truth is, God knows you completely and loves you unconditionally. In this 5-day plan through Psalm 139, you’ll discover the freedom, peace, and joy of being fully loved and fully known by your Creator. Each day blends Scripture, real-life stories, and reflection to help you walk closer to God in confidence of His love for you.
PlanThankYou: We would like to thank Jackie Bledsoe for providing this plan. For more information, please visit: https://drmary.expert/about

PlanIntro: "30 Days in the Word" isn't just a reading plan... it's a breath of fresh air for the soul! Every day you'll receive nourishment, strength, light, and direction straight from the heart of God. In a world that stifles faith, the Word is your spiritual survival. Read, pray, grow... and live! Let the Word live within you and become your joy, your weapon, your anchor. It's time to shine!
PlanThankYou: We would like to thank Carmelo Orlando for providing this plan. For more information, please visit: https://www.gesuilnazareno.org

PlanName: Find Hope in God's Unfailing Love
PlanIntro: God wanted you alive just so he could love you! The Bible repeatedly tells us that God is love—not that he has love; he is love. It is his nature, his character. In this 30-day reading plan, you’ll learn more about God’s love for you and how you can love him and others with his help. You’ll discover that the only reason there is any love in the universe is because your Creator is a God of love. And the only reason you are capable of giving and receiving love is because God made you in his image.
PlanThankYou: We would like to thank Rick Warren/Daily Hope for providing this plan. For more information, please visit: https://PastorRick.com

PlanName: Well Encounters- Finding Living Water in Unexpected Places
PlanIntro: What if your most unexpected moments could become encounters with the living God? This devotional explores how Jesus meets us at our spiritual wells, in our shame, need, and brokenness, offering the living water that truly satisfies and transforms unlikely meetings into launching pads for His purposes in our lives.
PlanThankYou: We would like to thank Rachel G. Scott & Friends for providing this plan. For more information, please visit: https://rachelgscott.com/

PlanName: Father’s Love:  30 Days of Discovering God as Father
PlanIntro: So many know God only through the lenses of their upbringing and unfortunately, some people only know Him by whatever false religion and human doctrines have boxed him in to be. Few people truly know and experience Him as Father and Daddy. This 30-day devotional invites you into the heart and many wonderful characteristics of God that will lead you deeper into His embrace, helping you see Him in a new light and truly come to Him at all times with boldness and confidence.
PlanThankYou: We would like to thank Women Thrive Global for providing this plan. For more information, please visit: https://www.womenthriveglobal.com
